queries.adql:
SELECT source_id, designation, ref_epoch, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, parallax_over_error, astrometric_params_solved, visibility_periods_used, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE parallax >= 163.078188686922
  AND parallax_over_error >= 10
  AND visibility_periods_used >= 8
  AND ruwe < 1.4
  AND astrometric_params_solved IN (31, 95)
ORDER BY source_id
